project.name: SPOT
project.description: SPOT eDiscovery platform: FastAPI backend, React 3.0 UI, a compose-based local stack with Playwright E2E.

repos.name: spot-api
repos.description: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy async + PG/MSSQL, owns openapi.json
repos.notes: MatterScoped on matter-scoped models + scenario fixture rows; emit_change for matter writes; Alembic migration + mssql twin for every schema change; ORM only.
review_checklist: right auth gate (require_admin vs require_admin_area vs require_export_request_admin vs require_svc_worker), never collapsed
emit_change in the same transaction for matter writes

repos.name: spot-ui3
repos.description: SPOT 3.0 UI: React + Vite + TS (biome, vitest)
repos.notes: SonarCloud: no nested ternaries, Readonly<> props on new components, no duplicated JSX/test harnesses (gate fails above 3% duplication). Figma icons are exported, never redrawn.
review_checklist: existing components and tokens, no hard-coded styles
typed API client, regenerated types committed

stack.login: make token EMAIL=dev@local (admin) or EMAIL=pm@local (non-admin); paste it in the Dev token sign-in form; 1h expiry
